Krea 2 LoRA integrated workflow - 2026-06-24

Base files from the original workflow:
1. text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
2. vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors
3. unet/krea2_turbo_fp8.safetensors

Krea 2 LoRAs: download into ComfyUI/models/loras/
- retroanime.safetensors | trigger: Purple retro anime style
- sunsetblur.safetensors | trigger: ethereal motion blur style
- vintagetarot.safetensors | trigger: vintage tarot style
- rainywindow.safetensors | trigger: rainy window style
- darkbrush.safetensors | trigger: monochrome ink wash style
- dotmatrix.safetensors | trigger: Monochrome stippling style
- neondrip.safetensors | trigger: Textured abstract style
- kidsdrawing.safetensors | trigger: naive expressive sketch style
- softwatercolor.safetensors | trigger: Art Deco watercolor style

Each row is one LoRA branch using Load LoRA strength_model=1.0 and strength_clip=1.0.
Sampler settings kept from your original workflow: 8 steps, cfg 1, er_sde, simple, fixed seed 0.
